schema.description: UpdateTemplateRequest is the request for updating a template.

coldBoot.description:
Android only: boot the emulator cold (-no-snapshot-load) and never save a
quickboot snapshot, so every open exercises a full first boot.

cores.description:
Android only: emulator CPU core count. 0 = sized to the host (cores/2,
clamped). Same mint bound + on-VM clamp as ram_mb.

deviceModel.description: Device profile hint (for example, "pixel_7"). Empty = platform default.

osVersion.description:
iOS only: the simulator runtime to boot, as an iOS version such as "18.2"
(or a simctl runtime id). Anything else, and any value on Android, is
rejected. Empty = the newest installed runtime. Reads back as the version.

platform.description:
Device platform: "android" (emulator, Linux stacks) or "ios" (simulator,
macOS stacks).

ramMb.description:
Android only: emulator RAM in MB. 0 = sized to the host (RAM/4, clamped).
Bounded at mint against the machine type's specs; clamped again on the VM
with a degradation notice if the host cannot honor it.

systemImage.description:
Android only: sdkmanager system image package (for example,
"system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64"). Empty = platform
default. Images not pre-installed on the stack fall back to the best
installed one with a viewer-visible degradation notice — they are never
downloaded at boot.

featureFlags.description: Updated feature flags (replaces all existing when update_feature_flags is true).

items.description: FeatureFlagCreate is used when creating a feature flag.

description.description: Description explaining what this feature flag enables.

image.description:
Updated image name (optional).

Superseded by stack_id (prefer it). Accepted for now and resolved to a stack id on the fly.

servicePorts.description: Updated service ports (replaces all existing when update_service_ports is true).

items.description: ServicePortCreate is used when creating a service port on a template.

description.description: Description shown next to the tunnel help.

localPort.description: Suggested local port for the tunnel. 0 means "same as port".

name.description: Short name of the service. Unique per template.

port.description: Port the service listens on inside the VM (1-65535).

sessionInputs.description: Updated session inputs (replaces all existing when update_session_inputs is true).

items.description: SessionInputCreate is used when creating a session input definition on a template.

defaultValue.description: Default value when not provided by the session starter. Only used when required is false.

description.description: Description explaining what this input is for.

exposeAsEnvVar.description: Whether to expose as an ENV VAR in interactive terminal sessions.

required.description: Whether this input is required. Defaults to false (optional).

stackId.description: Updated stack id (optional, for example, "osx-xcode-16.0.x-edge"). Preferred over image.

templateVariables.description: Updated template variables (replaces all existing when update_template_variables is true).

items.description: TemplateVariableCreate is used when creating a template variable.

exposeAsEnvVar.description: Whether to expose as an ENV VAR in interactive terminal sessions.

isSecret.description: Whether this is a secret value.

updateDeviceSpec.description:
Whether to update device_spec (false = don't touch, true = replace with
device_spec, or clear it when device_spec is unset).

updateFeatureFlags.description: Whether to update feature_flags (false = don't touch, true = replace with provided list).

updateServicePorts.description: Whether to update service_ports (false = don't touch, true = replace with provided list).

updateSessionInputs.description: Whether to update session_inputs (false = don't touch, true = replace with provided list).

updateTemplateVariables.description: Whether to update template_variables (false = don't touch, true = replace with provided list).

updateWorkspaceLinks.description: Whether to update workspace_links (false = don't touch, true = replace with provided list).

workspaceLinks.description: Updated workspace links (replaces all existing when update_workspace_links is true).

items.description: WorkspaceLinkCreate is used when creating a workspace link.

featureFlagName.description: Optional: name of the feature flag that controls visibility.
